opening.argument: The speaker directly ties making money to buying S9 mining robots, presenting the purchase as a route to financial gain. He then describes miners accumulating multiple cryptocurrencies and becoming "the great winners" of the cryptocurrency-mining industry. That sales-oriented appeal is reinforced by the presentation's claims that a robot became effectively free, that an investor will always win, and that a networker will become a millionaire, promising unusually certain and outsized financial outcomes. Although the speaker says investors can win or lose and that the industry's future is unknown, those qualifications conflict with the separate claims of certain winning and millionaire results.
